paragraphs.source_en: From the beginning, it had been perfectly clear that this campaign offered no hope of victory. Shuri could never measure up to her true father, Lord Azai Nagamasa... This thought sprang not only from longing for her father, but also from Chacha's fiercely competitive nature.

paragraphs.source_en: Nagamasa had indeed been a man brave enough to die for a warrior's honor; he had not entertained the slightest thought of placing his wife in a cruel predicament. But Katsuie was different. There was no sign in him of any wish to help his wife. He seemed to feel the same way about everyone else. No sooner had Katsuie returned than he assembled his remaining retainers, apparently intending to take them all with him down the road of no return. Yet even if every child and old person were gathered together, they would scarcely number three thousand. The outcome needed no further telling.

paragraphs.source_en: Once Chikuzen's army poured in, its first act would surely be to set fire to the castle town.
